title: Pack manifest (pack.json)
description: Identity, provenance and file list of a pack (principles.md, 'Packs').

language.description: Default text language of the pack: its text/<lang>.json is in files (BCP 47 tag, as obl.text).

provenance.description: converted: made by obl-convert from the user's copy, never committed; own: authored by us.

import.description: Opaque reference to the import this pack came from (converted packs only). Equal references mean the same imported copy; build detection, source paths and reports stay in the converter.

files.description: Every file of the pack with its hash and tier.
